run_parameters.title: Run parameters
run_parameters.description: Essential parameters for the analysis of epigenomic DBiT-seq experiments. Supports 'spatial' and 'bulk' run types. To process several samples at once, leave run_id, r1 and r2 empty and give a samplesheet under 'Samplesheet (multiple samples)' at the bottom.

run_id.description: ATX run ID with optional prefix, usually in Dxxxxx_NGxxxxx format. Cannot contain '/', '-', '.' or a space.
run_id.help_text: If ng_id is left at NG00000, the SLIMS ng_id is taken from the _NGxxxxx suffix of the run ID.

r1.description: Read 1 FASTQ. Must contain genomic sequence.

r2.description: Read 2 FASTQ. Must contain barcode sequences and end with >33 bp of genomic sequence.

genome_dir.description: Chromap genome directory, containing the *.fa and *.index for the reference.

barcode_file.description: Expected barcode sequences for the assay: bc50.txt for SOP 50x50, bc96.txt for 96x96, bc50_old.txt for the previous 50x50.
barcode_file.help_text: For a custom barcode file outside barcodes/, set params.barcode_file and params.positions_file in the Nextflow config field instead.

outdir.description: Output root. Use an s3:// path when running on AWS Batch.
outdir.help_text: Each sample is written to <outdir>/<run_id>/. Nextflow reports go to <outdir>/pipeline_info/.

read_filtering.title: Read filtering
read_filtering.description: Whether to skip filtering raw FASTQ reads on the ligation linker sequences. Turning off filtering is not recommended for standard preprocessing.

bulk_processing.title: Bulk processing
bulk_processing.description: Leave both options off for spatial runs.

bulk.description: Replace barcode sequences in reads with random barcodes (bulk).

no_ligation_bulk.description: Add linker sequences and assign random barcodes (no-ligation primer bulk).

data_tracking.title: Data tracking
data_tracking.description: Tracking of analysis metadata and metrics in SLIMS, primarily for AtlasXomics internal use. Credentials come from the SLIMS_USERNAME and SLIMS_PASSWORD secrets.

upload_to_slims.description: Upload run metrics (summary.csv) to SLIMS. If selected, provide ng_id unless run_id ends in _NGxxxxx.

ng_id.description: SLIMS ng_id (e.g. NG00001), if pushing to SLIMS and run_id does not end in an NG ID such as _NG00001.

advanced_options.title: Advanced options
advanced_options.description: Options for expert users. Not recommended for standard preprocessing.

blacklist_filtering.description: Remove fragments that overlap ENCODE blacklist regions.

genome_id.description: Genome ID. Leave empty to infer it from the *.fa file name.

positions_file.description: Spatial positions list for lane QC. Defaults to the list matching the barcode file.

min_fragments.description: Fragment floor for FRiP and per-cell metrics.

input_fragment_floor.description: Fragment floor for peak calling and the bigwig.

container.description: Container image for all processes. Defaults to atx-fastq2frags:<version>.
container.help_text: On AWS Batch, use your ECR image: <account-id>.dkr.ecr.<region>.amazonaws.com/atx-fastq2frags:<version>. Replace the placeholders with your deployment values. Use the -local tag with the test profile.

publish_dir_mode.description: How results are published to outdir.

signal_processing.title: Signal processing
signal_processing.description: These options need a correction table: xtalkTable.csv or cleanTable.csv, from the bcQC outputs for the run.

ds_table.description: Correction table (CSV) for cleaning and/or cross-talk correction.
ds_table.help_text: Cleaning needs columns mer and finalDownFract. Cross-talk correction needs mer, row, col, xtalk_mask and fold_above_background. Each step runs only when its toggle is on; without a ds_table it is skipped with a warning. Samplesheet rows can set their own ds_table.

cleaning.description: Clean FASTQ reads against the correction table before filtering.

xtalk_correction.description: Substitute fragments of cross-talk-affected barcodes with proxy reads from the nearest unaffected neighbor.

xtalk_threshold.description: Minimum fold_above_background for an affected barcode to be substituted. Barcodes below this are left unchanged.

samplesheet.title: Samplesheet (multiple samples)
samplesheet.description: Process several samples in one run. When a samplesheet is given, run_id, r1 and r2 above are ignored.

input.help_text: One row per sample. ng_id (SLIMS content ID) and ds_table (correction table) are optional per-sample columns.
